_comment: Manual curation decisions (ADR-0005). Every entry must state its reason. Reviewer: Claude Code main session, 2026-11-26 (self-review, not external validation).

intel-4004-min-clock-period.reason: Primary source (Intel MCS-4 datasheet) not read: value comes from a third-party transcription (pyntel4004) that does not cite its source; Intel secondary figures diverge (108 kHz / 740 kHz / 750 kHz). Held back until the original datasheet is consulted.

intel-4004-max-clock-frequency.reason: Derived from intel-4004-min-clock-period, which is held back (primary datasheet not read).

osu-latency-crossroads-8b.reason: Incomplete protocol: interconnect, MPI library, sample count and which of the two required tests (longest/shortest path, Table 4.6) produced the value are not stated. Verifier flagged it at the limit of 'inadequate'.

samsung-990pro-qd1-read-latency-derived.reason: Derived with Little's law from an 'up to' marketing IOPS figure with unstated block size: at most a lower bound on mean latency, misleading on a timeline of typical values.
